verses.text: A prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.

xrefs.text: The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He drives out the enemy before you, giving the command, ‘Destroy him!’
And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.

Therefore declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Although I sent them far away among the nations and scattered them among the countries, yet for a little while I have been a sanctuary for them in the countries to which they have gone.’
He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.

verses.text: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.

xrefs.text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
I say: “O my God, do not take me in the midst of my days! Your years go on through all generations.
“I am the Alpha and the Omega, says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come— the Almighty.
Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.

verses.text: You return man to dust, saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”

xrefs.text: By the sweat of your brow you will eat your bread, until you return to the ground— because out of it were you taken. For dust you are, and to dust you shall return.”
before the dust returns to the ground from which it came and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground; on that very day his plans perish.
If He were to set His heart to it and withdraw His Spirit and breath,

verses.text: For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night.

xrefs.text: Beloved, do not let this one thing escape your notice: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.
You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah
But understand this: If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.
Even if he comes in the second or third watch of the night and finds them alert, those servants will be blessed.
During the fourth watch of the night, Jesus went out to them, walking on the sea.

verses.text: You sweep them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—

xrefs.text: A voice says, “Cry out!” And I asked, “What should I cry out?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field.
Like one waking from a dream, so You, O Lord, awaken and despise their form.
For, “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,
They were snatched away before their time, and their foundations were swept away by a flood.
As for man, his days are like grass— he blooms like a flower of the field;

verses.text: in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers.

xrefs.text: Like a flower, he comes forth, then withers away; like a fleeting shadow, he does not endure.
that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.
For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its flower falls and its beauty is lost. So too, the rich man will fade away in the midst of his pursuits.
If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?

verses.text: For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.

xrefs.text: You discipline and correct a man for his iniquity, consuming like a moth what he holds dear; surely each man is but a vapor. Selah
Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.
And with whom was God angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more, so it may be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah
Therefore I was angry with that generation, and I said, ‘Their hearts are always going astray, and they have not known My ways.

verses.text: You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.

xrefs.text: For My eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from My face, and their guilt is not concealed from My eyes.
For God will bring every deed into judgment, along with every hidden thing, whether good or evil.
“Can a man hide in secret places where I cannot see him?” declares the LORD. “Do I not fill the heavens and the earth?” declares the LORD.
For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.

verses.text: For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.

xrefs.text: So He ended their days in futility, and their years in sudden terror.
You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah
For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night.

verses.text: The length of our days is seventy years— or eighty if we are strong — yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

xrefs.text: You do not even know what will happen tomorrow! What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.
He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.

I am now eighty years old. Can I discern what is good and what is not? Can your servant taste what he eats or drinks? Can I still hear the voice of singing men and women? Why should your servant be an added burden to my lord the king?
“My travels have lasted 130 years,” Jacob replied. “My years have been few and hard, and they have not matched the years of the travels of my fathers.”
Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died, yet his eyes were not weak, and his vitality had not diminished.

verses.text: Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.

xrefs.text: Who can withstand His indignation? Who can endure His burning anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; even rocks are shattered before Him.
The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling grips the ungodly: “Who of us can dwell with a consuming fire? Who of us can dwell with everlasting flames?”
then I will act with hostility toward you, and I will strike you sevenfold for your sins.
And if after all this you will not obey Me, I will proceed to punish you sevenfold for your sins.
Therefore, since we know what it means to fear the Lord, we try to persuade men. What we are is clear to God, and I hope it is clear to your conscience as well.

verses.text: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.

xrefs.text: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
“Show me, O LORD, my end and the measure of my days. Let me know how fleeting my life is.
While it is daytime, we must do the works of Him who sent Me. Night is coming, when no one can work.
If only they were wise, they would understand it; they would comprehend their fate.
Wisdom is supreme; so acquire wisdom. And whatever you may acquire, gain understanding.

verses.text: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.

xrefs.text: For the LORD will vindicate His people and have compassion on His servants when He sees that their strength is gone and no one remains, slave or free.
And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants.
Return, O God of Hosts, we pray! Look down from heaven and see! Attend to this vine—
So the LORD relented from this plan. “It will not happen either,” said the Lord GOD.

verses.text: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

xrefs.text: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?
I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.
Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,

verses.text: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

xrefs.text: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
“Comfort, comfort My people,” says your God.
Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and wail while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.
In that day you will say: “O LORD, I will praise You. Although You were angry with me, Your anger has turned away, and You have comforted me.

verses.text: May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.

xrefs.text: O LORD, I have heard the report of You; I stand in awe, O LORD, of Your deeds. Revive them in these years; make them known in these years. In Your wrath, remember mercy!
For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.
He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.
If You kill this people as one man, the nations who have heard of Your fame will say,
And the little ones you said would become captives— your children who on that day did not know good from evil— will enter the land that I will give them, and they will possess it.

verses.text: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands— yes, establish the work of our hands!

xrefs.text: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.
So neither he who plants nor he who waters is anything, but only God, who makes things grow.
Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope,
Your decisions will be carried out, and light will shine on your ways.
O LORD, You will establish peace for us. For all that we have accomplished, You have done for us.
